decisions.briefing: NASDAQ jumped +2.3% and S&P 500 +1.6% in a broad risk-on move, so per our playbook we're deploying idle cash into the strongest momentum setups rather than sitting on it. We opened three new positions (LFTO, AUR, FIVN) to fill our remaining slots while holding all existing winners unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today with the NASDAQ up 2.3% and S&P 500 up 1.6%, reflecting a wave of risk appetite across growth and tech-adjacent names. Breadth was strong, with dozens of stocks flashing bullish MACD crossovers and rising momentum histograms simultaneously, a pattern consistent with institutional buying rather than isolated speculation. No single catalyst headline was available in today's feed, but the uniform strength across small- and mid-cap names suggests a sector-wide rotation into risk assets.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤全面走強，納斯達克指數上漲2.3%，標普500指數上漲1.6%，反映市場風險偏好明顯回升，資金湧向科技及成長股。今日觀察到大量個股同步出現MACD黃金交叉及動能柱狀圖走升的技術訊號，顯示這波買盤較偏向機構資金進場，而非零星投機炒作。雖然今日新聞來源未提供具體催化消息，但中小型股普遍走強的現象，顯示市場資金正進行一輪風險資產的板塊輪動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, on the idea that strong recent performance tends to continue in the short term. Today we saw dozens of stocks with matching bullish signals (MACD crossovers, rising momentum, price above moving averages) at the same time, which is a classic momentum setup, so we deployed cash into the strongest of these rather than the most overbought ones.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資（Momentum Investing）是指買入近期已經呈現上升趨勢的股票，因為強勢表現在短期內往往有延續的傾向。今日我們觀察到大量個股同時出現吻合的看漲訊號（MACD黃金交叉、動能上升、股價站上均線），這是典型的動能行情，因此我們選擇將現金投入其中訊號最強但尚未過熱的標的，而非已經超買的個股。
